boundary: No transaction: ResourceServlet.doGet resolves the weblog (WeblogRequest.getWeblog) and, only if the resource is not found in the weblog's shared theme, falls back to JPAMediaFileManagerImpl.getMediaFileByOriginalPath (ResourceServlet.java:95-96); every read goes through JPAPersistenceStrategy.getEntityManager(false), no transaction opens, each read auto-commits. The file bytes come from FileContentManagerImpl (filesystem), not the database.
